name: Sample 6
description: Classic paper terminal report with ruled sections, formal grading table, remarks, and signature blocks.

config.css: .report-template { font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; color: #111827; background: #fffdf7; border: 3px double #1f2937; padding: 24px; max-width: 980px; margin: 0 auto; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(31, 41, 55, 0.08); } .classic-header { text-align: center; border-bottom: 3px double #1f2937; padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; } .classic-header h1 { font-size: 28px; margin: 0; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .classic-header p { margin: 4px 0; font-size: 13px; } .classic-title { text-align: center; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; margin: 10px 0 12px; } .classic-subtitle { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 16px; } .identity-grid, .metrics-grid, .signature-grid, .traits-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 14px; } .identity-grid td, .metrics-grid td, .signature-grid td, .traits-table td, .traits-table th { border: 1px solid #374151; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 13px; vertical-align: top; } .identity-grid .label, .metrics-grid .label { display: inline-block; min-width: 120px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px; } .subject-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 14px; font-size: 12px; } .subject-table th, .subject-table td { border: 1px solid #374151; padding: 6px 8px; text-align: left; } .subject-table th { background: #e5e7eb; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .subject-table td:nth-child(2), .subject-table td:nth-child(3), .subject-table td:nth-child(4), .subject-table td:nth-child(5), .subject-table td:nth-child(6) { text-align: center; } .metrics-grid td { width: 25%; } .classic-split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; } .panel { border: 1px solid #374151; padding: 10px; min-height: 110px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); } .panel h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; border-bottom: 1px solid #9ca3af; padding-bottom: 4px; } .grading-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11px; } .grading-table th, .grading-table td { border: 1px solid #6b7280; padding: 4px 6px; text-align: center; } .grading-table th { background: #f3f4f6; } .traits-table th { background: #f3f4f6; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .traits-table td { font-size: 12px; } .signature-line { margin-top: 34px; border-top: 1px solid #111827; padding-top: 4px; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; } .declaration { border: 1px solid #374151; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 11px; margin-top: 10px; } .footer-note { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 12px; font-style: italic; } @media print { .report-template { border-width: 2px; box-shadow: none; } }
